items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: My dad took me to hear Segovia. I just flipped out as a kid.

ctx.x: Now you started out on the French horn? Is that correct?

Yes I did. Both my parents were classical musicians. My dad was a Juilliard graduate, studied clarinet, and I grew up in San Diego. I was born in New York City while he was attending Juilliard. I came to San Diego — I’m almost a native — at probably age three or something like that, and studied the horn for twelve years. Wanted to play in an orchestra like my dad, that was my ambition. Loved the classical guitar. Somehow I got this great interest in classical guitar. My dad took me to hear Segovia. I just flipped…
Beach Boys stuff and all that?
